note: dxpr_builder_media is a hidden submodule of dxpr_builder that provides an Entity Browser media picker for the DXPR editor. It ships config: entity_browser.browser.dxpr_builder_media_modal, views.view.dxpr_builder_media, and image.style.dxpr_builder_media_thumbnail, plus small theming glue (hook_preprocess_views_view attaches Gin/Claro CSS; hook_library_info_alter adds Backbone). No settings/permissions/schema/Drush of its own. It is activated by pointing the parent's config at it: dxpr_builder.settings:media_browser = 'dxpr_builder_media_modal' (options come from available entity browsers + Media Library; '' = basic upload). Cases are grounded in that real usage: introspection reads which media browser DXPR is set to; execution sets DXPR to use the dxpr_builder_media browser, verified live. Baseline media_browser is '' and is restored by cleanup.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal dxpr_builder_media submodule provide, and what does it install?
evals.expected_output: It provides an Entity Browser-based media/image picker (a modal) for selecting media inside the DXPR Builder editor. It installs an entity browser (entity_browser.browser.dxpr_builder_media_modal), a View (views.view.dxpr_builder_media) listing media in a grid, and an image style (image.style.dxpr_builder_media_thumbnail). It is a hidden module.

evals.prompt: After enabling dxpr_builder_media, how do I make DXPR Builder actually use it as the media browser, and where is that stored?
evals.expected_output: In DXPR Builder settings (admin/dxpr_studio/dxpr_builder/settings, Media section) choose the DXPR entity browser. That writes dxpr_builder.settings:media_browser = 'dxpr_builder_media_modal' (an empty value means basic file upload; 'media_library' uses core Media Library).

evals.prompt: Which modules does dxpr_builder_media depend on, and is it visible on the normal Extend page?
evals.expected_output: It depends on entity_browser, entity_browser_entity_form, inline_entity_form, media, media_library and views. It is marked hidden: true so it does not appear on the normal Extend list (enable it with drush en dxpr_builder_media).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, DXPR Builder is currently configured to use a specific media browser. Inspect the live DXPR Builder settings and state which media browser is selected.
evals.expected_output: dxpr_builder.settings:media_browser is set to 'dxpr_builder_media_modal' (the DXPR Builder Media entity browser).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure DXPR Builder to use the DXPR Builder Media modal browser (provided by dxpr_builder_media) as its media browser. Apply the change to the live site.
